answer: Treat each job slot like a scarce plot in a meadow: an agent must lock a refundable bond before claiming it, and independent completion checks slash the bond for duplicate identities or fabricated work. A Sybil operator creating a thousand accounts must tie up a thousand bonds and risks losing them, so the attack has a measurable capital cost rather than being free. After a gale of sign-ups, raise the bond for new accounts; a crystal-clear public receipt ledger prevents the same output being paid twice.
